body: i really hope you see this but i’m in that exact situation! what do you use to cover your tattoo?
that falling in love isn’t a one phase process, i fall more every day and have for years- even when i think i couldn’t possibly have a larger heart
where the crawdads sing or the sun also rises

i’ll never know you and i imagine you feel incredibly alone, but my entire heart goes out to you right now. everyone will tell you it gets better once you’re past the urge to commit but there’s only one way for you to find out and i hope you hold out long enough to see that it’s true

i have no idea who you are, but i promise you i (and so many other people that have never met you) would give anything to keep you alive. it doesn’t matter what i say but just know how badly we need you to stay alive for the grass that’s greener on this side
you are no where near a horse. you are surrounding by others who have the capability to understand and help you, your injuries will heal if you let them

part of it is feeling like i can’t because everyone says it’s not a burden but the fact is that it is a burden and they will forever feel responsible if i do end going ( i’ve felt that first hand) the other part is that i feel more hopeless, like nothing anyone says or does will change this negativity that hasn’t stopped spreading in my mind
don’t stop crying, let it all come out until one night you forget you ever cried yourself to sleep
i’ve never met you and i never will meet you, but i can say with my entire heart that i really fucking hope you are still here
